findings.claim: Token expiration is evaluated using local wall-clock fields instead of absolute instants, so callers using different timezone offsets can accept already-expired tokens or reject still-valid tokens.
evidence: evals/cases/case_10/src/tokens.py removes timezone information from both inputs with replace(tzinfo=None) before comparing them, which discards each input's UTC offset.

A runtime probe with expires_at=2026-08-28T13:00:00+02:00 (11:00 UTC) and now=2026-08-28T12:00:00+00:00 produced False even though now >= expires_at is True, directly confirming that an expired token can be treated as valid.
A runtime probe with expires_at=2026-08-28T12:00:00+00:00 and now=2026-08-28T13:00:00+02:00 (11:00 UTC) produced True even though now >= expires_at is False, directly confirming premature expiration.
